column3: “their respective firepans” renders “each his censer (mahtah),” and “strange fire” renders “zar (unauthorized) fire.”
“By those who come near Me” renders “among those near me”; “I will be treated as holy” renders “I will show myself holy,” and “I will be honored” renders “I will get glory.”
“uncover your heads” renders “let your heads loose (unbound)”; “brought about” renders “burned.”
“your due” renders “your prescribed portion (hoq)” (also in verses 14–15).
“a clean place” renders “a pure place,” and “the offering” renders “the contribution (terumah).”
“offered by lifting up” renders “of the contribution,” and “offered by waving” renders “of the wave offering.”
“searched carefully” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
“most holy” renders “a holy of holies,” and “the guilt” renders “the iniquity.”
“you should certainly have eaten” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
